turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's use it. Why is there a zero on Owen's essay, and why did I find out from his phone?
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
You're asking me how to do your job? I'm here as Owen's mother, and my question was why the zero went in before anyone called me. Answer it.
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
That's your household, Hale, not mine. I'm here about Owen, and you still haven't told me who decided on the zero or whether anyone spoke to him first.
